summary: Frontend testing of iter115 Profitability Calculator dual-mode. Calculator panel (both modes) and mode-aware Projections table PASS with correct anchor values. Operation dialog M1/M2 flow BLOCKED by a critical ReferenceError crash when switching op dialog to 'direct' mode.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: computeDirect is not defined — crashes the OperationDialog (React error boundary shows 'Algo salió mal') the instant the user clicks op-mode-direct. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/profitability/OperationDialog.jsx line 10 only imports { computeUnit, fmt } from './calc' but line 41 calls computeDirect(...). Also emptyForm() (line 14-17) never sets an initial 'mode', so form.mode is undefined until a mode pill is clicked (works as combined by falsy check, but any downstream code assuming 'combined'|'direct' will misread it).

integration_issues.issue: Cannot create an M1 operation via the dialog — clicking op-mode-direct crashes the dialog, so op-sell/buy/buypct inputs and op-submit-btn become unreachable. Blocks the entire 'QA M1' anchor test (client 'QA M1', USD/CUP, 1, 952, 700, 26 → net 70). M2 submit path was not tested because the dialog was destroyed by the M1 crash during the same session.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/profitability/OperationDialog.jsx add computeDirect to the import from './calc': `import { computeUnit, computeDirect, fmt } from './calc';`
In the same file update emptyForm() to include `mode: 'combined'` so the initial state is explicit (also aligns with the pill highlight)

After the fix, re-verify: open dialog → op-mode-direct → op-sellpct-input should be hidden, fill 1/952/700/26 → op-preview-net = '70 CUP' → submit → row in profit-ops-table with blue M1 badge; then a second M2 op (715/740/26/37 → net 53,65) with purple M2 badge; delete both.
critical_code_review_comments: OperationDialog.jsx: missing `computeDirect` import causes runtime crash on Mode 1 selection — not caught because the previous iter113 didn't have direct-mode code path; suggests no unit test for the dialog's preview.
OperationDialog.jsx emptyForm() should include mode default; relying on undefined-as-falsy is fragile.
Duplicate React key warning observed in an unrelated select ('TEST_X' key) — outside scope of this iter but worth surfacing.
Also saw a 429 (rate-limit) on some API calls during navigation — non-blocking for this feature.

rca of the issue: OperationDialog was extended with a mode toggle (iter115) but the import statement on line 10 was not updated to include computeDirect from ./calc. When form.mode transitions to 'direct' the preview expression `computeDirect({...})` throws a ReferenceError during render, which propagates up and the ErrorBoundary replaces the dialog with the generic 'Algo salió mal' screen. Reproduction: open profitability tab → click profit-add-op-btn → click op-mode-direct → app crashes. Mitigation: 1-line import fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/profitability/OperationDialog.jsx.
